caption: The drawing depicts three main objects and two outline diagrams on a cream-colored background. On the left, there is a detailed, colored illustration of the internal mechanism of a pocket watch. The colors used are primarily gold and silver with accents of black. The watch case is gold with inner gears and mechanisms in both gold and silver tones; small screws and several components are shaded in black or dark gray. The watch mechanism is inscribed with the text "E. Howard & Co. Boston 41666" in cursive script. Above this component is the gold winding crown and loop. To the right of this mechanism image, there are two simple black outlines: a circle labeled "FRONT (exact size)" and an elongated oval labeled "THICK (exact size)," which likely represent the actual dimensions of the watch. Further to the right is a detailed, gold medallion-like design, which appears to be the decorative case back of the watch. This circular gold object features an embossed pattern with a horse's head, floral motifs, stars, and ornamented borders. The background remains plain with no shading or coloration outside the illustrated objects.
title: Watch, Frame and Case
